an8.59:1.1: LIX. Aṭṭh' ime bhikkhave puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. Katame aṭṭha? Sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmī sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, arahā arahattāya paṭipanno. Ime kho bhikkhave aṭṭha puggalā āhuneyyā . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā ti.
an8.59:2.1: Cattāro ca paṭipannā cattāro ca phale ṭhitā: esa saṅgho ujubhūto paññāsīlasamāhito.
an8.59:3.1: Yajamānānaṃ manussānaṃ puññapekhānapāṇinaṃ karotaṃ opadhikaṃ puññaṃ saṅghe dinnaṃ mahapphalan ti.
